tools.name: decode_vehicle
tools.description: Decode a 17-character VIN into make, model, year, trim and body style. Use it whenever the customer gives a VIN.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List NHTSA's model names for a make and year, narrowed by a search word. Use it to find the exact model name.

tools.name: get_recalls
tools.description: NHTSA recalls for a make, model and year. The only source of recall campaign numbers you may cite.

tools.name: search_complaints
tools.description: Owners' complaints to NHTSA for a vehicle: totals, top components, and the 5 newest matching ones. Complaints are not recalls.

tools.name: get_safety_rating
tools.description: NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings for each variant of a vehicle.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the store's parts catalog for a vehicle. A part is confirmed only when the body style is given and listed.

tools.name: create_handoff
tools.description: Pass the customer to a person. Use it for refunds, orders, an upset customer, a request for a person, or anything you cannot answer from your tools.

first.title: A hand-written agent loop, not a framework

steps.title: Plan with sources
steps.text: The plan came first: each piece of technology, why it was picked, and the provider's own docs for how it behaves, read before relying on it.

steps.title: Write the test, watch it fail
steps.text: Each change starts with a test, and it has to fail on the old code for the reason expected before the code is written.

steps.title: Change the code
steps.text: Small steps, each with its tests. What the model must not do is checked by code after it answers, not only asked for in the prompt.
steps.fact: 6 rules checked in code, with 6 test files of their own

steps.title: Measure on real runs
steps.text: Real Claude runs are recorded with the tokens, cost and time the API reported, then replayed on this page at no cost.
steps.fact: 6 real runs recorded, $0.20 measured in all, $0.0059 to $0.0961 each

steps.title: Independent review
steps.text: Code reviews every answer before a customer sees it, and a reviewer with fresh context reads each change that touches money, the live model or more than one area.
steps.fact: The rules sent back 1 of 6 recorded real answers; 1 passed on the retry

steps.title: Deploy, then check live
steps.text: The page is built fresh and uploaded, then the live site is checked: the page itself, the API's status, and requests that must be refused.
steps.fact: The production build runs inside the test suite on every change
